

== Japanese Premiere printing documentation ==
Confirmed Japanese Premiere printing 1301_18o, source index 4039 on p.99 of the collecting encyclopedia. The original Japanese face was visually inspected; verified field scope and source hash are retained in the batch evidence. The PSA holder label says LIN-V8M; the physical card face clearly says LIN-V8K. Card identity follows the face and checklist, not the holder label. Missing transcription and fields still requiring source review are explicitly identified. Printing identity does not establish GEMP implementation.<ref name="encyclopedia">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41 and 99 (index 4039). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
